messages:
cami (sec-eng): FYI staging restore pipeline started failing yesterday night. saw a string of AccessDenied on KMS Decrypt during automated restores. probably related to last-week IAM cleanup.

noah (eng-ops): confirmed. ot-bot logs: 
```
OT-BOT: KMS.Decrypt ERROR
key_arn=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/abcd-ef01
principal=arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/svc-backup-uploader-staging
error=AccessDeniedException
ct_request_id=r-0a1b2c3d
```

lisa (db-ops): we renamed backup-uploader -> svc-backup-uploader during the IAM cleanup. did we regenerate grants? KMS grants are attached to principal ARNs so rename would invalidate old grants.

mike (sre): looks like the grant TTL expired and the role rename meant no new grant was present. two short term asks: 1) emergency restore path for humans; 2) automation to avoid repeat.

cami (sec-eng): for compliance we also need the full audit trail for any emergency action (who created grant, request ids, etc). auditors will ask for evidence linking decrypt calls to grant create/delete events.

noah (eng-ops): temporary mitigation: I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/489 which attaches a policy to the renamed role to allow kms:Decrypt until we implement automated grants. please review.

lisa (db-ops): long term: propose a canary decrypt job in staging that runs hourly and validates the latest snapshot header decrypts with the snapshot key. will fail loudly if AccessDenied. canary also writes a small metadata blob: {kms_key_arn, snapshot_id, decrypt_request_id}.

mike (sre): add correlation alert: trigger when CloudTrail shows IAM RolePolicyChange OR RoleRename within last 30m AND there are KMS AccessDenied events for the same principal/key. currently we only alert on KMS errors but not the config change.

cami (sec-eng): agreed. also prefer ephemeral grants for restore flows (short TTL) to reduce blast radius; but we need automation that creates grants at restore start and records grant_id into the restore ticket. auditors want CreateGrant/DeleteGrant events plus the Decrypt call id.

noah (eng-ops): question: what TTL? suggestions: 12h for manual restores, 30m for CI-driven restores. add tag `ci=true` on the grant resource for policy and evidence filtering.

lisa (db-ops): implementation sketch for the canary CronJob (k8s):
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: kms-decrypt-canary
spec:
  schedule: "@hourly"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: canary
            image: amazon/aws-cli
            command: ["/bin/sh","-c","aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://canary.enc --output json | jq -r '.KeyId' > /tmp/canary_meta && echo \"$(date -u)\" >> /tmp/canary_meta && cat /tmp/canary_meta | aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-staging-canary/{{cluster}}/kms-canary/$(date -u +%s).meta.json"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
```

mike (sre): make that emit a Prometheus metric (canary_kms_decrypt_success{env="staging"}). alert if >3 failures in 2 hours. also log CloudTrail request id to the metadata blob.

cami (sec-eng): runbook updates: add steps to recreate grants (aws kms create-grant --key-id <arn> --grantee-principal <arn> --operations Decrypt) and capture the grantId. include how to handle cross-account restores (can't grant across accounts reliably) — require re-encrypt-to-target-key or proxy account flow.

noah (eng-ops): I'll add a small file into restore artifacts with keys: kms_key_arn, grant_id, decrypt_request_id, actor, expires_at. store under s3://redwood-restore-evidence/<restore-id>/evidence.json.

lisa (db-ops): also run a one-off audit recovery for last week's role rename: search CloudTrail for CreateGrant/DeleteGrant entries around the rename window and match Decrypt failures. we need to populate the evidence file retroactively for any failed restores.

mike (sre): make sure alerting deduplicates repeated AccessDenied events (they can be noisy). tie to a single incident ID and attach the IAM change event link in Slack.

cami (sec-eng): action items and owners: 1) merge noah's temp policy and rollback after automation (owner: noah). 2) add the canary CronJob + metric (owner: lisa). 3) implement correlation alert (owner: mike). 4) update encryption/runbook with grant create/delete steps and audit evidence checklist (owner: cami). 5) retro-audit for the role rename window and attach evidence to the restore tickets (owner: lisa).

noah (eng-ops): filing ticket INFRA-1123 to track the canary + correlation alert + evidence flow. will link PRs.

ot-bot (audit-bot): Ticket INFRA-1123 created: "KMS decrypt canary, grant lifecycle automation, and IAM-change correlation alert".
